results.question: My iron repletion follow-up says my ferritin improved. Can you explain what changed during 2022 using my reports?

messages.content: My iron repletion follow-up says my ferritin improved. Can you explain what changed during 2022 using my reports?

Your ferritin rose from 11 ug/L in January to 34 ug/L by May 2022, indicating improved iron stores after treatment. Hemoglobin remained stable around 124-130 g/L, staying within the normal adult female range. The follow-up note states you completed an alternate-day iron course through August and were advised to continue dietary iron. Your mid-luteal progesterone result was 38 nmol/L, which falls within the reference interval of 16–80 nmol/L. The report notes that a single value cannot assess luteal quality. My maternal discharge summary is here. Can you help me review the birth and my recovery using that report?

I can help you review your maternal discharge summary. The report shows you had a term IVF singleton pregnancy delivered vaginally at 39+2 weeks on July 29, with a second-degree tear repaired and 350 mL blood loss. Your hemoglobin was 106 g/L on July 30, and you were afebrile and normotensive during your stay. Discharge medications include prenatal vitamins, ferrous sulfate every other day, and ibuprofen or acetaminophen as needed for pain. You were advised pelvic rest until comfortable and healing is assessed, with follow-up calls and an exam scheduled. Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, fever, chest pain, breathlessness, severe headache, leg swelling, or self-harm thoughts.
